name: mom-monorepo
description: MOM 모노레포: npm run dev = 시연 데이터 서버(:8765) + 화면(Next :3000), npm run dev:full = 백엔드(FastAPI :8000)까지

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:api && npm run setup:sim && npm run setup:web
scripts.setup:api: cd backend && python -m venv .venv && cd .. && node scripts/py.mjs -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:sim: cd 생성기 && python -m venv .venv && cd .. && node scripts/py.mjs @gen -m pip install -r requirements.txt
